scope: Actual pinned native sources only; no database or native API executed

findings.finding: DOM databases enable WAL and retain DatabaseOptions no_sync=false, giving NORMAL synchronous mode.
no_sync is false by default; no_sync=true selects OFF, otherwise WAL uses NORMAL.
CheckpointDatabase delegates to WalCheckpointImpl; the private implementation can return success without new page backfill.
Sandboxed VFS xSync forwards to the actual File::Flush status. It does not synchronize the containing directory.
The wrapper owns disk or memory LevelDB; the new path refuses memory Env and failed-commit simulation.
Write with a non-null empty WriteBatch still adds a log record and calls logfile Sync when options.sync is true.
sqlite3PagerJrnlFile returns the active WAL file when pWal exists.
Checkpoint syncs WAL and database during backfill. That work is conditional; no-backfill success is insufficient as an unconditional file-sync acknowledgment.

limits: File data sync is not directory durability, native authority, complete writer quiescence or a multi-store journal.
Runtime fault and actual-app acceptance remain unperformed.
integrationPreflight: The first integrate.py invocation refused its incorrectly resolved repository parent before creating its replay directory or modifying any file. The parent selection was corrected before the recorded successful replay.
